_readme: Shanku Revit bridge settings. All keys are optional; delete a key to use its default.
port: the localhost port the bridge listens on (default 7071). Shanku must use the same port.
extraOrigins: more web addresses allowed to call the bridge, besides Shanku's own sites
(https://shanku.vercel.app and its previews, GitHub Pages, and localhost dev servers).
Restart Revit after changing this file.
